viv: hitting a replay/ordering glitch when auth refresh + reconnect happens mid-event. Short repro and notes below.

viv: repro: emit a single large SSE `data:` (8-12KB). If token refresh triggers reconnect while bytes are streaming, client sometimes emits a corrupted JSON or duplicated fragments.

omar: did SDK tag connection epoch? If not, buffer tail from old conn can join head from new conn.

node-sdk: current behavior: buffer += chunk; split on `\n\n`; parse each. No epoch tagging.

py-sdk: we discard partial buffer on reconnect by default. That avoids corruption but loses the partial event. Node should match.

proxy-bot: note: recent http2 window change may increase mid-event fragmentation; rolling this week.

viv: proposed fixes:
- SDK: add connection-epoch id and drop partial buffer on reconnect by default (config: discardOnReconnect=true).
- SDK: treat comment-only lines (`:`) as invisible (pre-strip) so heartbeat lines don't force flush.
- Optional: enableChunkSeq to let client reorder small windows based on `id: req-xyz:chunk-N`.

omar: add integration test to sample-app: short TTL token + large event. New hires keep tripping on this during onboarding.

node-sdk: will PR small change and tests. py-sdk to align parsing.

viv: tagging ops if proxy can reduce reordering during restarts. If anyone sees similar logs, paste raw bytes (base64 ok) here.
